question: How is the all-limbed form to be treated after the eight-hundredfold chanting?
premises: The all-limbed form is well pressed with love-arrows.
inference: The verse intensifies the rite by pressing the all-limbed form with love-arrows.
uncertainties: The referent of sarvāṅgī is not explicitly named.
plain_english: Then, more: the all-limbed one is well pressed with love-arrows.
